long_biography.plain_text:
At Grantley Hall, hotelier Richard Sykes worked with chef Shaun Rankin on EightyEight, a restaurant pairing Asian cooking with local produce. He recruited a marketing team a year before opening, giving the new hotel time to establish its identity before welcoming guests.

Sykes also helped shape its fitness facilities, selecting equipment he considered closely suited to the available space. He told the supplier that the team had studied leading hotels for ideas while seeking facilities guests would not ordinarily expect. Its two-storey ELITE gym includes a dedicated strength and conditioning space and a studio for spinning, yoga and Pilates.
